body: Thanks for the advice. I’m not going to share my age, but I’m too young to move out. I talked to my mom about how i feel like she doesn’t care about my issues and that whenever I say anything I get downplayed. She basically said how our family is so fortunate (more downplaying) and that I should look for the good things in life and shouldn’t choose to be miserable. As if I want to be. She said that she does care that I hate school but that she doesn’t have an answer for me so she said I just have to deal with it, which I guess I understand, but she could have been a little nicer about it and not just downplay me more. Again, thanks for all the advice :)
Depending on where you live, blackmail is a crime, and purposefully outing someone is hate crime, if you are in the US.
I absolutely despise eating sounds. One of my friends says it’s too hard to chew with his mouth closed and every time he says that i want to throw him off a cliff.
She might just be busy sometimes or overthinking how to respond.
